# xtfont-atlas - the shared text ground truth of the pixel platform.
#
# WHY: the original asks only for new Font("SansSerif", 1, 13) and
# new Font("SansSerif", 1, 11) (every site in xtGraphics.java). The
# container maps logical SansSerif bold onto the shipped
# tools/fonts/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf via
# tools/fonts/fontconfig.properties, so THIS raster is reproducible
# inside tools/pixel-tests.Dockerfile and nowhere else guaranteed.
# Era-exactness is approximate (2005 JRE platform fonts are gone);
# reproducibility is exact and is what the pin protects.
#
# FORMAT xtfont-atlas/1 (plain ASCII, parse without Java):
#   - '#' lines are comments.
#   - 'key=value' lines below are the manifest; unknown keys are
#     ignorable additions.
#   - 'glyph <pt> <codepoint_dec> <advance_px> <cell_dx_px>' rows:
#     one per codepoint per size. The grid cell is
#     col = codepoint - 32, row = 0 for 13pt, 1 for 11pt;
#     its pixel origin is (grid_x + col*cell_width,
#     grid_y + row*cell_height). The glyph was drawn at
#     (cell_x + cell_dx, cell_y + baseline) with drawString.
#   - advance is the REAL java.awt.FontMetrics.charWidth(codepoint),
#     i.e. the integer pen advance used by stringWidth.
#   - pixels are black glyphs on an opaque white TYPE_INT_RGB
#     canvas; text antialiasing is the toolkit default.
format=xtfont-atlas/1
png=atlas.png
png_width=1900
png_height=44
png_type=INT_RGB
cell_width=20
cell_height=22
grid_x=0
grid_y=0
columns=95
rows=2
codepoint_min=32
codepoint_max=126
baseline=16
glyph_count=190
row0_size=13
row0_ascent=12
row0_descent=3
row0_leading=1
row0_max_advance=17
row0_height=16
row1_size=11
row1_ascent=10
row1_descent=3
row1_leading=0
row1_max_advance=15
row1_height=13
sha256_ttf=788abee4c806d660e8aee46689dd8540cd4bb98da03dcc9d171ce3efd99a9173
ttf=tools/fonts/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf
sha256_png=0625138d319b96df6245e552955f770a475db02a5e76baf36351b75ab606522d
